request: The accent chairs look odd and are lined up against a wall. Replace them with visually simple, compatible seating and arrange a useful cozy conversation area. You may replace the living-room furniture; keep the other rooms unchanged.

arguments.style_request: Remake the living room in minimalistic style but cozy. The accent chairs look odd and are lined up against a wall. Replace them with visually simple, compatible seating and arrange a useful cozy conversation area. You may replace the living-room furniture; keep the other rooms unchanged.

reply.message:
I’d replace the terracotta lounge chair with simple upholstered seating facing the sofa around the coffee table—not lined along a wall.

However, the catalog returned no compatible, sized replacement seating or complete set, so I couldn’t create a checked preview or quote a cost. Nothing has changed, including the other rooms; your budget remains unconfirmed.
